execution.mechanism: klt sim --backend batch (2am EDA batch fleet, Spot)
execution.timing_note: elapsed_s per corner is the remote engine wall clock reported by klt (runtime_s). job_elapsed_s is the fleet harness's own job time. queue_provision_and_transfer_s = submit-to-collect wall minus job_elapsed_s (S3 upload, Spot acquisition/boot, polling granularity, download).

experiment.claim: spec/topology-survey.md Startup row ("self-starting, < 1 ms") -- the startup-TIME half, on the cell that would actually be fabricated. Measures, in a single transient per PVT point, how long the ROUTED, LVS-clean bandgap-core layout (issue #62) -- which since issue #285 DRAWS design/startup_injector.sch inside the composed cell (MPC1, MPC2, MNS, MNI, MNC, QS) -- takes to bring VOUT up after the supply arrives, on a slow ramp, on a fast ramp, and from the worst case of all: placed *in* the degenerate zero-current state at full supply and asked to leave it. The DUT is the composed cell ALONE: this bench instantiates design/bandgap_core.sym with NO separate design/startup_injector.sym instance, because the extracted body already contains one, and it carries NO bare-core control copy, because the drawn cell cannot express one (issue #299 -- see the 'dropped measurements' note below for what that costs and where those claims still live). The extracted core comes from klt extract --parasitics translated to a simulatable netlist (sim/bin/post_layout_common.py), NOT design/bandgap_core.sch directly -- see 'Netlist provenance' below. The schematic-level counterpart of this claim, WITH its bare-core control copy, is sim/startup-ramp/ (report row 8c); the no-other-stable-state half on this same composed cell is the sibling post-layout bench sim/startup-stability-post-layout/; the +/-1% output-accuracy claim is issue #11.
experiment.provenance_source: layout/bandgap-core/reports/20260923-070209-dbd57a9/bandgap_core_routed.gds via `klt extract --parasitics` (layout record 20260923-070209-dbd57a9), translated by sim/bin/post_layout_common.py, over this bench's own sim/startup-ramp-post-layout/testbench/tb_startup_ramp_pl.sch
experiment.statistical_convention: N/A (corner-matrix claim, not a distribution claim)
experiment.title: Startup: supply-ramp transient startup time of the COMPOSED LAYOUT CELL against the < 1 ms spec line -- POST-LAYOUT (extracted netlist)
